linux/broker.org.agentmesh.profile-log.broker.service:
[Unit]
Description=AgentMesh profile log broker

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=:"/synthetic/python" "-m" "agentmesh_log.cli" "broker" "run" "--home" "/synthetic/home"
UMask=0077
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

linux/catch-up.org.agentmesh.profile-log.catch-up.servi:
[Unit]
Description=AgentMesh profile log catch-up

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=:"/synthetic/python" "-m" "agentmesh_log.cli" "migrate" "catch-up" "--db" "/synthetic/db" "--mapping" "/synthetic/mapping" "--agent-key" "/synthetic/agent"
UMask=0077
linux/catch-up.org.agentmesh.profile-log.catch-up.timer:
[Unit]
Description=AgentMesh migration catch-up

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30
OnUnitActiveSec=300
Unit=org.agentmesh.profile-log.catch-up.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
